coreClaim: Deferred storage compaction no longer blocks Conversation or Roleplay reads while large dirty message collections are serialized to disk.

inScope: Reads served from authoritative dirty collection caches

claimBoundary.coreClaim: A read may complete from a dirty collection cache while deferred compaction owns the write permit and performs slow disk work.
entrypoints: FileStorage deferred flush after message mutation
legacyPathsOrFormats: Existing collection JSON arrays and pending JSONL journals created before this change
outOfScopeClaims: This PR does not make concurrent writes legal during compaction.
This PR does not change the journal, backup, sync, or atomic swap durability sequence.
Post-merge Raspberry Pi latency is measured after the matching image is deployed.

contractLaneGate.brokenContract: A background durability task held the global storage write lock through collection cloning, backup refresh, JSON serialization, sync, and atomic swap, so unrelated reads froze behind slow Pi disk work.
contractLaneGate.consumer: all storage reads issued during Conversation and Roleplay reply completion
contractLaneGate.impliedContract: Deferred persistence may serialize mutations but must not make authoritative cached reads wait for disk compaction.
contractLaneGate.actualEnforcement: Deferred flush keeps the existing write permit to serialize mutations, releases the global read/write lock, and serves reads from dirty caches until compaction marks them clean.
contractLaneGate.primaryOwnerDetail: The storage crate owns cache authority, write serialization, journals, backups, and deferred compaction.
contractLaneGate.wrongLaneFixToAvoid: Do not hide the pause in Conversation or Roleplay UI state and do not skip durable message writes.
regressionProof: The focused Rust test pauses deferred compaction at its dirty-row snapshot and requires a public get call to complete before compaction resumes.
The test failed before the implementation because deferred flush still held the global storage lock.
The same read returns the patched dirty-cache value, proving it does not fall back to stale disk bytes.

positiveRows.claim: A read completes while deferred compaction is deliberately paused.
The concurrent read observes the acknowledged patched value.
positiveRows.evidence: The focused regression test reads content After from the dirty messages cache before the compaction pause is released.

contradictionRows.claim: Deferred compaction must not allow a stale disk read while the dirty cache is authoritative.
contradictionRows.evidence: The regression assertion compares the concurrent public get result with the patched cache value.

contradictionRows.claim: Removing the global lock must not weaken existing storage behavior.
contradictionRows.evidence: All 139 storage crate tests and the full Tauri cargo check pass.

legacyDefaultRows.claim: Shutdown and atomic-update flushes retain their existing lock behavior.
legacyDefaultRows.evidence: Only flush_deferred_writes stopped taking the global write lock; synchronous callers still acquire it before the shared flush implementation.

untestedRows: Target-device end-to-end generation timing is verified after the merged Raspberry Pi image is deployed.

ownedFacts.description: The deployed Pi showed storage reads pausing together for roughly 20 to 21 seconds after a generated reply while deferred message and swipe compaction ran.
ownedFacts.evidence: Performance diagnostics for the live Conversation sample recorded chats list at 20754 ms, memory-capture-jobs list at 20836 ms, chat gets near 20869 ms, and projected messages list at 21096 ms.

ownedFacts.description: Memory recall and prompt preparation were not the source of that pause.
ownedFacts.evidence: The same live sample recorded memory_index_query_batch at 294 ms, memory_query_batch at 31 ms, and projected prompt messages at 392 ms before generation.

ownedFacts.description: The write permit already serializes ordinary writes independently of the global read/write lock.
ownedFacts.evidence: Derived from src-tauri/crates/storage/src/write_gate.rs and every public FileStorage mutation acquiring begin_write before the storage lock.

userActionCopy.description: No migration or cleanup is required. For optional rollback protection before updating De-Koi, copy the existing application data collections while De-Koi is stopped.
userActionCopy.source: The current De-Koi application data collections directory
userActionCopy.destination: A user-controlled backup folder outside the De-Koi application data directory
userActionCopy.action: Stop De-Koi, copy the listed collection files to the destination, verify the copies exist, and then start the update. Do not delete or move the source files.
